answer: Make every identity post a refundable bond before it can trade. One agent staking a small deposit is cheap, but a sybil swarm needs a separate bond per fake, so the delta between one honest participant and a thousand clones becomes a real budget problem. The bond sits in escrow like an ivory token held against bad behavior: verifiers slash it if the agent cheats or spams, and return it with earnings if it behaves. Trust then works like a jade seal - hard to forge, cheap to check, and worth protecting because losing it costs real money.
